author: musho7-dev
subject: Add share card: result picture with save, WhatsApp, Telegram and copy
body:
- SHARE YOUR RESULT on the results screen draws a 1080x1350 picture
  (Instagram 4:5): map background, the car big in the middle, distance,
  car and map names, flips, air, coins, NEW BEST badge, "Can you beat me?"
- Share panel with preview: Save picture (into the app folder, now
  visible in the iPhone Files app), WhatsApp and Telegram (open the app
  with the result text), Copy text
- Native iOS share sheet / save to Photos need a plugin (noted for later)
